metadata.title: Fix password_change_required flag not clearing after API password change
metadata.author: Nayana-R-Gowda

description:
Signed-off-by: NAYANAR <nayana.r7813@gmail.com>
closes #1842


Fixed API password change flow by clearing password_change_required after a successful password update.

Ensured the user entity is attached to the active SQLAlchemy session before persisting the flag.

Aligns API behavior with Admin UI to prevent infinite password-change-required loops.

commits.message:
Fix password_change_required flag not clearing after API password change

Signed-off-by: NAYANAR <nayana.r7813@gmail.com>
commits.author: NAYANAR

commits.message:
fix: improve password change handler robustness and add regression test

- Add None check after user re-query to prevent AttributeError on race condition
- Return early on re-attach failure to avoid token with empty team claims
- Remove redundant flag clearing (already handled by EmailAuthService)
- Keep session re-attachment for safe get_teams() access in token creation
- Add regression test verifying password_change_required is cleared (#1842)

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti
